newsitem.title: USA: Foremost says court cuts damage awards.
newsitem.headline: Foremost says court cuts damage awards.

text.p: Foremost Corp of America said Tuesday the Alabama Supreme Court last Friday sharply reduced punitive and compensatory damages totaling more than $15.5 million awarded to three people in June of 1995.
Foremost said the court reduced the compensatory damage awards to $3,300 from $12,500 and the punitive damage awards $348,000 from $15.5 million.
The insurance holding company said the plaintiffs had accused a Foremost agent of promising free insurance and selling unnecessary coverage.
Foremost shares were off 3/8 Tuesday at 60-1/4.
